title: Marc Maron Starrer ‘In Memoriam’ to Kick Off 11th Annual Indie Street Film Festival; Full Lineup Revealed (Exclusive)
summary: The Red Bank, New Jersey-based event will feature Garden State premieres of Adam Meeks' Will Poulter-starring 'Union County,' set for closing night, Charlotte Glynn's 'The Gymnast,' Danny Madden's 'Downbeat' and Walter Thompson-Hernández's 'If I Go Will They Miss Me.'
